Complex Analysis YouTube playlists

• Taking Complex Analysis this semester?

Don’t stress, here are some key playlists to make it way easier 

Steve Brunton : Crash Course in Complex Analysis (engineering-focused, clear explanations)

The Bright Side of Mathematics : Complete Complex
Analysis series (visual + rigorous)

MathMajor : Step-by-step full lectures (great for beginners)

Richard Borcherds : Cambridge Professor’s course (theory-heavy, deep insights)

Mathemaniac : Essence of Complex Analysis (visual + intuitive)

The Math Coach : Full Complex Analysis Lectures (tons of examples + proots)

- Save this so you can come back during revision week!
